description: Fire, aviation and emergency facilities is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Ontario | Gouvernement de l'Ontario. Facilities used by the Ministry of Natural Resources' Aviation Forest Fire and Emergency Services (AFFES) branch. This dataset is used to support aviation forest fire and AFFES business operations. Coverage: Government of Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Ontario | Gouvernement de l'Ontario. Its tags are Economy and Business, Environment and Natural Resources, Law and safety, Government information, Économie et affaires. It offers 8 resource(s) in ESRI REST, HTML, OTHER, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-03-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Ontario. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
